title: The test ratchet must refuse a stale baseline (or derive it)
description: The ratchet let .test-baseline.json go stale: test-skills#14 added 18 cases and #15 raised the cap to 79, and neither advanced the baseline (still 60 while the suite is 79), so every later PR inherits phantom +19 growth and fails max_new_tests_per_pr. Fix by making the gate REFUSE a merge whose baseline is below the collected count on the base, or by deriving the baseline instead of hand-keeping it. Decided as DEC-209 on opum-doc dev (accepted, read 2026-10-19): REFUSE, and no run-time derivation; the stored baseline is the auditable reference and moves only through the Article XIII amendment path. Admitted for implementation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A recorded baseline that does not match the base commit's measured test count fails the gate by name. It prints both numbers and the base SHA, and names the Article XIII amendment as the only way to move the baseline. A mismatch in either direction never passes.
There is no run-time derivation. The stored baseline stays the auditable reference.

Proved both ways: an equal count passes, and one count below and one above each fail by name with both numbers. A mutation that skips the comparison turns those two green, and the suite must catch it.
Review: Stage 1, or opum-doc's Opus review by ref if it touches a CI workflow file.
